column2: Originating in ancient times, the Thalmor are a mixture between a political party and a shadowy cabal, created with the objective of stablishing Elven Supremacy over Tamriel, and the arrival of a new Merethic Era.
The High Emissary of the Thalmor.

Order [Root.GetFirstName] to join the Thalmor. [Root.GetFirstName] will be granted the rank of Agent and can immediately take on Guild jobs and study Specializations if there are any available to [Root.GetHerHim].
Thanks to my contact in the Thalmor, I have access to some of the finest trainers and instructors available. With their help, I can receive training in a variety of advanced specializations.
